info.description:
Drive proxymock from CI jobs and scripts: pull and push snapshots, run the mock server, replay traffic against the application under test and score the result.

The API is served by `proxymock mcp run --http` on the machine that runs the job, next to the MCP endpoint at /mcp. It listens on 127.0.0.1 by default.

Authentication:
- X-Proxymock-Token: the server's access token. Required when the server listens beyond loopback (--host), optional on loopback.
- Authorization: Bearer <Speedscale API key>: runs cloud operations as that key's user. Without it, the server uses the login of the machine it runs on.

Long-running operations answer 202 with a job. Poll GET /v1/jobs/{id}, or pass ?wait=<seconds> to block for up to 10 minutes.

Versioning: everything under /v1 except /v1/experimental is stable. New optional fields and new operations can appear in a minor version; removing or renaming a field or changing its meaning needs /v2.
